use_cases: Continuously scrolling text announcements across a hero or landing page
News ticker-style breaking updates that adjust speed based on scroll velocity
Promotional brand messages or taglines with eye-catching animation
Loading state or attention-grabbing text movement
Scrolling feature lists or benefit highlights in a product showcase
ai_summary: A scroll-velocity-responsive text marquee component that smoothly animates text across the viewport. Features configurable base speed, optional scroll-dependent acceleration, and a start delay. Text scales to 8vw for responsive sizing and uses motion/react for buttery-smooth GPU-accelerated animation. Perfect for news tickers, announcements, or eye-catching promotional text on any landing page or hero section.
